verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe fetched an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document unauthenticated at /openapi/mesh-api.json, covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s on guessed standard paths do not contradict this, because the documented spec location works. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the spec's location, versioning and completeness (the docs reference is a single brief mention).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: you can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema
Observed unauthenticated documentation GET HTTP 200; parsed OpenAPI 3.0.3.
